subject: chemistry
description: Past year questions on Fundamental Principles, Hydrocarbons, Aromatic Hydrocarbons, Basic Concepts

questions.question: Write the IUPAC name of: CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃
questions.solution:
Longest chain: 4 carbons = butane
OH on C-2 → **Butan-2-ol**
questions.knowledgeNote: IUPAC priority: carboxylic acid > ester > aldehyde > ketone > alcohol > amine > alkene/alkyne.

questions.question: What is resonance? Draw resonance structures of ozone and benzene.
questions.solution:
**Resonance:** When a single Lewis structure cannot describe a molecule, multiple structures (resonance contributors) are needed.

**Ozone (O₃):** O=O-O ↔ O-O=O (two equivalent structures)
**Benzene (C₆H₆):** Two Kekulé structures with alternating double bonds — actual structure is a resonance hybrid with equal C-C bond lengths.
questions.knowledgeNote: Resonance stabilization energy of benzene ≈ 152 kJ/mol — explains its unusual stability.

questions.question: How is ethane prepared from ethene? Write the reaction mechanism.
questions.solution:
**Addition of H₂ across the double bond (hydrogenation):**
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂ → CH₃-CH₃

Conditions: Ni/Pt catalyst, heat (~200°C)

**Mechanism (catalytic hydrogenation):**
1. H₂ adsorbs on metal surface
2. C=C π-bond breaks and C-H bonds form
3. Ethane desorbs from catalyst surface
questions.knowledgeNote: Alkenes undergo addition reactions; alkanes undergo substitution (free radical).
